# SaltWatch Card 0.5.3

This release makes missing-device guidance consistent throughout Home Assistant without exposing development-only information to card users.

## What changed

- The card editor now clearly reports **No SaltWatch devices found** when Home Assistant has no compatible device.
- The editor explains that a SaltWatch device must first be connected to Home Assistant before reopening the card editor.
- The card preview and **Add to dashboard** card picker now show **SaltWatch device required** instead of incorrectly asking users to select a device that may not exist.
- English and German guidance were updated together.
- Development emulator information remains limited to project documentation and is not shown anywhere in the card interface.

## Compatibility

- Existing configured cards are unaffected.
- No YAML configuration changes are required.
- SaltWatch Card continues to require an official SaltWatch device running firmware 2.0.0 or newer.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 39 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- The release workflow rebuilds and publishes the checked JavaScript asset.
